learner: A 12th-grade graduate from India. Limited English vocabulary. Studied in a non-English-medium school. Starts from zero in AI. Wants to start an AI career.
pass_rule: A lesson ships only when EVERY check passes. No partial credit.

checks.question: Did the writer return lesson text?
checks.writer_rule: Always return the full lesson, including on retries. Do not return only a change summary.

checks.question: Does every sentence have 15 words or fewer?
checks.writer_rule: Keep every sentence at 15 words or fewer. Write one idea in each sentence.

checks.question: Is the Flesch Reading Ease score 60 or higher?
checks.writer_rule: Use short, common words. Choose the simple word when two words mean the same.

checks.question: Is the lesson free of idioms, slang, and Latin short forms (e.g., i.e., etc.)?
checks.writer_rule: Do not use idioms, slang, or short forms like e.g., i.e., or etc. Say the plain words.

checks.question: Is every technical term defined in the same sentence or the next sentence where it first appears?
checks.writer_rule: When you use a technical term for the first time, define it right there, in the same sentence or the next one.

checks.question: Can the learner understand every technical word from the lesson alone?
checks.writer_rule: Do not use any technical word that the lesson does not explain in simple words before or where it is first used.

checks.question: Is every factual claim in the lesson supported by the fact sheet?
checks.writer_rule: Write only facts that are in the fact sheet. If the fact sheet does not say it, leave it out.

checks.question: Does the lesson cover all key points?
checks.writer_rule: Cover every key point in the list. Check the list again before you finish.

checks.question: Is the lesson between 400 and 900 words?
checks.writer_rule: Keep the lesson between 400 and 900 words.

checks.question: Does the lesson use an everyday analogy AND a worked example, and are both correct?
checks.writer_rule: Include one everyday analogy and one worked example that follows a real question through every step.

checks.question: Are the sections present and in this order: what, why, how, example, summary?
checks.writer_rule: Use these section headings in this order: What is, Why, How, Example, Summary.

checks.question: Does each idea build on the earlier ones, with no idea used before it is explained?
checks.writer_rule: Explain every idea before you use it. Each section must build on the one before.
